{"citations":[{"source_id":"ch_7675130d841f32c8","quote":"We are organized into seven reportable segments (also referred to as divisions), as follows: 1) Frito-Lay North America (FLNA), which includes our branded convenient food businesses in the United States and Canada; 2) Quaker Foods North America (QFNA), which includes our branded convenient food businesses, such as cereal, rice, pasta and other branded food, in the United States and Canada; 3) PepsiCo Beverages North America (PBNA), which includes our beverage businesses in the United States and Canada; 4) Latin America (LatAm), which includes all of our beverage and convenient food businesses in Latin America; 5) Europe, which includes all of our beverage and convenient food businesses in Europe; 6) Africa, Middle East and South Asia (AMESA), which includes all of our beverage and convenient food businesses in Africa, the Middle East and South Asia; and 7) Asia Pacific, Australia, and New Zealand and China region (APAC), which includes all of our beverag…"}],"answer":"As of FY2022, PepsiCo is organized into seven reportable segments (divisions) corresponding to its primary operating geographies:
1. Frito-Lay North America (FLNA) — United States and Canada
2. Quaker Foods North America (QFNA) — United States and Canada
3. PepsiCo Beverages North America (PBNA) — United States and Canada
4. Latin America (LatAm) — Latin America
5. Europe — Europe
6. Africa, Middle East and South Asia (AMESA) — Africa, the Middle East and South Asia
7. Asia Pacific, Australia, New Zealand and China region (APAC) — Asia Pacific, Australia, New Zealand, and China region","confidence":1,"rationale":"The 10-K explicitly lists PepsiCo's seven reportable segments and their geographic coverage.","needs_review":false}
